special_cases: building sub-rows: each parcel's buildings (status planirani / postojeći / dogradnja / nadogradnja / 'dogradnja i nadgradnja', footprint, koef., spratnost, BRGP per building) are printed ABOVE its bold parcel row (the sub-rows' osnova adds up to the parcel's površina osnove) and may start on the previous page; they carry no parcel number and no parcel value comes from them
floors trap: the sub-row printed just below a parcel row belongs to the next parcel and its 'spratnost' often differs from the parcel's 'max. spratnost' (A123 max P, next row P+1)
two floor columns: 'spratnost' belongs to a building row, 'max. spratnost' to the parcel
a floor range: F3289 (page 49) max. spratnost 'Po+P+5-7', its sub-rows P+7 / P+6 / P+5
floor notations with basement / attic / roof terrace: 2Po+P+7, Po+P+3+Pk, P+1+Pk, P+2+Ps, P+4+Ps
printed zeros: A166 (K) states IZ 0.0 and II 0.0 (a stated 0 is a value, not a blank)
IZ at or above 1: 1.0 on many parcels, 1.2 on F3360/1 (as printed)
land use as legend codes (SS, MN, U, CD, SV, VO, K, SR, TS): the legend is on the land-use sheet, not in this table
parcel numbers carry the zone letter (A99, F3398), with /n sub-numbers (D3080/1) and letter suffixes (A156a, E3147b); TS 5 has a space; the 'oznaka' letters a / b / c label buildings, not parcels
zone totals 'ukupno A'..'ukupno F' (area, objects, IZ, II ...); 'UKUPNO' on page 57 is the plan-wide total (not a block)
text layer: the parcel numbers of pages 25-56 are in a font our AutoCAD glyph-shift decoder mistook for shifted text ('D3078' read as 'aPMTU'); fixed in preprocess 1.1
not_covered: heights in metres, building lines, setbacks, parking, green area, utilities: not in this table (these fields must stay blank)
ranges of the 'P+2 do P+4' kind: only the compact 'Po+P+5-7'
values stated once for a whole block: zone totals are sums, not rules
parcels listed twice: every parcel number appears once
gazette, decision number and date, area: not on these pages
